discovery: AFS income figures are gross and the publication's own columns don't sum to its grand totals — show composition (grants/rates/LPT/charges), never a single net number.
LA AFS capital appendix is a 10-col statutory template carrying the funding split; NOTES never itemise so there is no note-miner; minutes are 2025-26 titles only.

Councils publish landscape/views/wind on their OWN ArcGIS orgs; validate a layer by EXTENT not name. Superseded 2026-08-06 by a national sweep (32 more layers ingested, council_org_registry.csv built, last-edit date shown to lie) — the 07-20 59->85 count is stale, check the sweep card first.
The EPA agglomeration layer is WMS-only (no clean FeatureServer), which is why the sewered-town-site false positive persisted; needs the WMS path not a normal feature query.
NEVER digit-strip ABPCASEID; no mean centroids; the 38-row nearby-appeals set publishes TARGET as the decision date.
register_views uses swallow_errors=True, so a mis-registered view fails SILENTLY and the column just goes missing downstream — check the register return, don't trust an empty result.
Attendance denominator must exclude non-voting roles; the Ceann/Leas-Cheann Comhairle (e.g. McGuinness since Feb 2025) is a FALSE POSITIVE that raw turnout wrongly shames.
Procurement-awarded, payments, and budget are three separate money grains that never union/sum; TED overlaps awards so NEVER sum TED into them.
Only 2 join keys exist (ORG vs PERSON); the spine is PROCUREMENT-anchored so non-suppliers are ABSENT, and 0=not-matched is NOT the same as absent — never silently upgrade it.
NEVER Read a parquet to learn its shape (tens of MB floods context); call describe_dataset / list_datasets MCP tools served from fact_cards.json.
camelot is NEVER declared as a dependency; its opencv clash breaks SIPO, and uv sync PRUNES undeclared packages — install/pin deliberately, don't assume it's present.

In ministerial diaries 'Microsoft Teams'/'Webex'/'Cisco' in venue tags are the VIDEO PLATFORM not a lobbyist — a subject-matcher false positive; and the gov WAF trips on sustained bursts, not a lone GET.
SessionStart 'MCP server code BROKEN (PermissionError)' is usually a FALSE ALARM — py_compile can't write __pycache__ under a file lock; verify with an import before investigating.
Streamlit does NOT leak past utility/ (zero core/api/services/etc reach it); real lock-in is 174 widget call sites, not the 36.5k-LOC presentation layer — scope a migration off that, not LOC.
Every existing gate checks CORRECTNESS, none checks COMPLETENESS vs the source — that gap is how the AFS funding-split omission survived; audit against the source doc, not just internal consistency.
Before asserting a known figure, check the VERIFIED FINDINGS REGISTER (has an anti-facts section); it decays, so re-query before publishing rather than trusting a cached number.
For 'where does X live?' call the search_project MCP tool (one call) before repo-wide Grep; outline(file) then a scoped Read beats reading whole files.
Use search_project / outline / view_deps for code scans; ast-grep UNDERCOUNTS (misses dynamic/concatenated forms) so don't trust its zero.
Read the LG DOMAIN engine before ANY council work — it holds the power model AND a list of claims that are WRONG; several intuitive council facts are false.
The ABP inspector corpus is an ML/RAG asset, but it contains PII — NEVER build a people-search over it.

Engine calibration vs inspector reports quantifies over-flagging; under-firing traces to layer coverage, not rule logic — fix coverage before tuning rules away. Superseded 2026-08-07: solar energy_cert re-measured at 0% (excluded_uses:[solar_farm] shipped) — the 07-20 0.7%/4.7% figures are stale, check the current calibration card.
Iris Oifigiúil corporate/appointments parsing is FIXED (07-20); the page-splitter gaps are still open — check which before assuming a parse failure is upstream.
The NOAC-extended dataset is ALREADY promoted — don't rebuild it; check existing gold before pulling it again.
When app figures differ from a news number, a grain mismatch is NOT an error — check the AFS lane (e.g. Galway Crown Square €44.7m was a lane difference, not a bug).
Provenance is the USER's domain: no inference in UI copy, don't promote to gold without data-anchored evidence, only Verified renders as plain fact — lower bands surface as a caveat or not at all.
READ THE CODE before asserting a defect — don't infer a bug from a function/file NAME or a memory; a wrong confident claim is the costliest failure mode.
Polars import can HANG via a WMI call on this box — a known trap; if a script freezes at import, this is why.
Planning/design DISCUSSION is exempt from the brevity rules — explain in full; but evidence bands stay binding.
Personal insolvency records are privacy-quarantined — treat as PII; don't surface individuals.
IPAS has publication-grade findings that MUST surface: HIQA inspection gaps, the same 9 firms recurring, €251m awarded with no tender — check the memory before re-deriving.

If a private Siting nav tool returns nothing, check the index actually built before believing the absence. project_index._tracked() branched on .git-siting overlay PRESENCE, not on whether it lists files; the overlay retired tracking 2026-08-08 but stayed on disk, so search/refs returned empty for 13 days while refresh() reported a clean {'indexed': 0, 'errors': []}. Fixed 2026-08-21 to take the first source that lists files (0 to 960). siting_code_outline was never affected because it reads the file directly.

Low MCP nav-tool adoption is often the RAM guard, not the caller's habit. guard_mcp_memory.py refuses every MCP call below 1500 MB free and its own message says 'fall back to Read/Grep'; on 2026-08-21 it blocked 62 of 105 attempted MCP calls (59%) with 26 Claude processes on a 16 GB box. Close surplus sessions before blaming the reflex, and never read a guard refusal as 'the tool found nothing'.

The Grep tool DOES work inside planning/product (verified 2026-08-21) - the older 'Grep is blind there' note is stale and drove 1591 bash-grep invocations in a single day. Glob is the unreliable one now: it times out after 20s on planning/product (node_modules) and on data/ (.rgignore). Only Bash find/ls proves absence.

Never advise ending a session on context size alone - user feedback 2026-08-21: 'sometimes the long sessions are very valuable'. A long session on ONE thread is often cheaper than restarting, because ending it means re-deriving the state it already holds. The signal is size PLUS a topic change. Offer /compact (keeps session and task, drops spent work) before any handoff, and reserve /clear for genuinely unrelated work. The lever valid in every case is stopping context from GROWING: index spans over file dumps, subagents for bulky sweeps, bounded Reads.

Keep the original session as captain and sole writer; use cross-session sidecars only for distinct read-only scout or reviewer lanes. Run roots, assign a stable task key, bind the packet to the exact Git snapshot, and use tools/dev.py sidecar-handoff. A queue receipt is accepted_unconsumed, not delivered; confirm delivery with status, and let only the target integrate and verify. Compact instead when size is the only issue.

`docker system df` is Docker's BOOKKEEPING, not the filesystem - always discharge a disk claim with `df -h /` before/after. Two ways it misleads, both hit 2026-08-24: (a) Windows/WSL2 - pruning took images 104.3GB->9.9GB while docker_data.vhdx stayed 158GB; only elevated `diskpart compact vdisk` (after `fstrim`, which TRIMmed 589GiB) recovered it, 158.31->24.17GB and C: 84.4->232.2GB free. NOTE `wsl --manage --set-sparse` does NOT apply - it targets the distro root VHD, not docker_data.vhdx. (b) Linux/Hetzner - 8.78GB moved from Images into Build-Cache-reclaimable, which looked like 'nothing was freed', but `df` showed 13GB genuinely returned. Local: `python tools/dev.py docker-gc`.

Treat a Tailte ArcGIS UUID as identity, never entitlement. Admit only exact public CC-BY item -> matching direct service/layer -> Query/schema/count/OID contract -> receipted local snapshot. Public MapGenie WebMap config is only a source graph: its 18 declared utility services returned structured 403/restrictive terms on 2026-08-26; do not fuzz, token-guess or tile-scrape. The separate direct open-data group yields real candidates, but geometry/GUID-only HVD siblings are not worth ingesting without a named reviewer question.

If even echo fails before process startup with apply deny-read ACLs, inspect the Codex sandbox log and deny_read_acl_state.json before blaming rg, Git, MCP, or the repo. The Aug 24 and Aug 26 incidents were malformed state (22 NUL bytes on Aug 26). Use the installed DailTracker-CodexSandboxGuard or tools/codex_windows_sandbox_guard.ps1: it retries, preserves the corrupt files, and lets Codex regenerate state; never reset broad ACLs or read sandbox secrets.

A measured proposal described only in a dated plan is evidence, not tracked work: it can disappear from a condensed handover even when it is the safest near-term improvement. For private Siting performance work, read and update planning/product/doc/PERFORMANCE_EXECUTION_LEDGER.md. Every live candidate needs a stable ID, state, evidence scope, safety or measurement prerequisite, bounded next action, and proof needed to change state; do not promote a microbenchmark or silently drop a blocked item.

A native speed path may tokenize only an already-decoded PDF content stream; it is not a generic PDF parser or renderer. Keep pypdf authoritative in shadow mode, make direct mode acknowledgement-only and fail closed without fallback, and block every non-disabled tokenizer mode from external releases until a versioned specific-refusal corpus, real four-worker capacity receipt and issued-PDF propagation evidence exist. The 13-case corpus is a minimum seed. The deployed scan pool is already four spawned workers on a four-vCPU host; the observed 17-23% reduction applies only to one serial final-byte scan, not a full job, GPU or Hetzner claim.
